selection.name: Serena (C02)
selection.role: Primary semantic symbol and reference navigation. Use it when the question requires symbol identity or cross-file references.
selection.install_command:
uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent
serena init
serena setup claude-code
serena setup codex

basis.shows: The free language-server backend provides symbol lookup, source navigation and referencing-symbol queries. This directly fits exact semantic navigation, subject to each language server's coverage.
Documents MCP setup for both Claude Code and Codex. Also reports Claude tool-use regressions and a workaround; successful configuration alone does not prove agents will call the server.
September 30 language-test run: all inspected Ubuntu batches succeeded. Several macOS batches succeeded, but native macOS was cancelled; one Windows batch failed.
Published evaluations record calls, payloads and prerequisites for both toolsets, but agents select tasks and evaluate themselves. They do not establish independent measured superiority.
Default-branch commit on 2026-09-30, within 90 days. Repository metadata confirms it is not archived; issue activity continued on October 1.

selection.name: ast-grep (C09)
selection.role: Complementary structural source search for questions expressed as AST patterns.

basis.shows: Documents source-pattern search using tree-sitter ASTs, wildcards and structural rules. Its CLI supplies question-driven structural matching; syntax matches do not establish semantic reference identity.
Release published 2026-08-31 includes Linux x86_64 GNU and macOS arm64 binaries. Linux binaries fit the WSL2 userspace target; WSL2 execution was not tested.
Coverage, formatting and NAPI lint jobs succeeded at the inspected default-branch commit. These checks support maintenance quality, not comparative navigation accuracy.
Default-branch commit on 2026-09-28, within 90 days. Repository metadata confirms it is not archived; issue activity continued on October 1.

not_selected.name: gitnexus
not_selected.reason: Active October 1, September stable release and passing platform checks; its indexed search, references and impact analysis are credible, but reviewed evidence does not establish exact-answer or total-cost superiority over selective semantic and structural navigation.

not_selected.name: codebase-memory-mcp
not_selected.reason: Active October 1 with a September release and documented Linux/macOS arm64 builds; broad graph coverage is useful, but semantic refinement covers fewer languages, and its [published functionality benchmark](https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/blob/cb7d937638f77fb67aacc39444f6a6709d217d51/docs/BENCHMARK.md) does not compare the selected approach.

not_selected.name: Glean
not_selected.reason: Active October 1 with successful CI; its symbol facts, cross-references and Angle queries fit sophisticated structural analysis, but require indexer and client assembly beyond the selected repositories' documented agent workflows.

not_selected.name: jCodeMunch
not_selected.reason: Active and released October 1 with successful Ubuntu harness checks; byte-exact retrieval and optional SCIP references are credible, but its [largest token comparison](https://github.com/jgravelle/jcodemunch-mcp/blob/5804d7e77b423f6dd22218adcba370d2ea0c7c9c/benchmarks/METHODOLOGY.md) omits answer quality and uses whole-file reads as the baseline.

not_selected.name: token-savior
not_selected.reason: Active August 10 with a July release and passing checks; its [August remeasurement was withdrawn](https://github.com/Mibayy/token-savior/blob/73e9c7f56fd7cd40ecc72cdc4b032264018f8b4f/README.md) because only one of 143 sessions called its server, while older headline results lack a public harness.

not_selected.name: scip, zoekt and universal-ctags
not_selected.reason: All three default branches are active; SCIP requires language indexers and a consumer, Zoekt provides indexed text search, and ctags supplies tags. The composite needs additional assembly to deliver the shared exact-reference agent workflow; ctags' latest stable release is older than 90 days.

not_selected.name: CodeGraph
not_selected.reason: Active October 1 with a September release and both target-platform builds; its [corrected experiment](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/blob/ec738ec7a322a680dae39a904194ce9271e6873f/docs/benchmarks/residual-context-occupancy.md) measures workflow savings but increased resident retrieval context, without grading exact answers or measuring index costs.

not_selected.name: claude-plugins-official
not_selected.reason: Active September 30; TypeScript and Pyright plugins provide genuine Claude Code language-server navigation, but Codex integration was not established in the reviewed repository and plugin READMEs. It remains a strong Claude-specific comparison arm.

layers.deciding_comparison: The selection is based on documented capability fit, not demonstrated performance superiority. On frozen representative WSL2 repositories, compare Serena plus ast-grep with jCodeMunch plus SCIP, codebase-memory-mcp, CodeGraph and GitNexus; include native source-read/search controls and Claude's official LSP plugins. Seal exact source and reference answers before running. Include known-source reads, aliases, shadowing, cross-file references, structural questions and edits that invalidate indexes. Measure precision/recall, task success, cold setup and indexing, incremental updates, latency and full-session tokens. Assert actual tool use in every enabled session. Repeat relevant checks on macOS arm64.
evidence_gaps: No recorded comparison in the packet; reviewed upstream evidence does not separate the leading candidates on the complete requirement.
Target programming languages are unspecified, so language-server and semantic-index coverage remain material uncertainties.
No clean installation or target-host execution was performed. Serena's macOS native CI batch was cancelled; specific WSL2 and macOS arm64 backend combinations remain unverified.
Serena's evaluations are agent self-evaluations. Its documentation reports Claude tool-use regressions, making per-session tool-call verification essential.
jCodeMunch's separate Windows A/B report measured 18/25 native versus 20/25 enabled successes; it is useful evidence but does not compare these candidates on WSL2.

codebase-memory-mcp's 159-language evaluation document is a plan, not a completed comparative result. CodeGraph's corrected experiment does not establish exact-answer correctness or index amortization.

All candidates are nonarchived and have default-branch commits within 90 days. Recent issue activity was observed throughout; Glean, Zoekt and the plugin directory reported no GitHub releases. These facts do not by themselves rank navigation quality.
Research used 30 GitHub API calls: 26 REST and four GraphQL requests, with zero web searches. No GPU-dependent requirement was identified for the selected navigation tools.
